stage: question-first editorial draft before local candidate tables
independence: Author saw legacy and prior packet; not blind or independently validated. Fresh held-out probes must come from another reviewer.

questions.text: Why does a metal spoon warm in a hot drink?
questions.interpretation_seed: Contact heat transfer and temperature are distinct observables.

questions.text: Can an object gain energy without getting warmer?
questions.interpretation_seed: Energy transfer does not universally imply temperature rise.
Fluid circulation and heat transport, without equating all convection with buoyancy.

questions.text: How can a campfire warm a face without contact?
questions.interpretation_seed: Radiative transfer rather than contact-only relation.

questions.text: How does an unbalanced push change motion?
questions.interpretation_seed: Net force and vector acceleration require frame and classical regime.

questions.text: Can motion change while speed stays the same?
questions.interpretation_seed: Direction vs speed; root Velocity/Speed mismatch blocks mapping.

questions.text: What changes when a gas is squeezed?
questions.interpretation_seed: Pressure, volume, temperature and process conditions.

questions.text: Do two touching objects eventually reach the same temperature?
questions.interpretation_seed: Equilibrium under suitable isolation, not unconditional law in ontology.

questions.text: Why do equal pushes affect heavy and light objects differently?
questions.interpretation_seed: Inertial mass vs amount of substance.

questions.text: Is warmth a property or something transferred?
questions.interpretation_seed: Temperature vs heat transfer, avoid heat as stored substance.

questions.text: When does heating begin and end in this experiment?
questions.interpretation_seed: Bounded episode vs ongoing heat-transfer process.

questions.text: Does an insulating layer stop all energy transfer?
questions.interpretation_seed: Restricted conductance not absolute absence of radiation.

questions.text: Can a stationary object exert a force?
questions.interpretation_seed: Force interaction vs motion; no velocity predicate from interaction alone.

questions.text: How much thermal energy passes between the two bodies?
questions.interpretation_seed: Transfer quantity requires a process interval, not stored energy alias.

questions.text: Does a missing temperature reading prove cooling stopped?
questions.interpretation_seed: Open-world evidence state, not physical stasis.
